card.fact_statement: 2024 YR4 was discovered at the Chilean station located at Río Hurtado.
card.source_span: The asteroid was discovered by the Chilean station of the Asteroid Terrestrial-impact Last Alert System (ATLAS) at Río Hurtado on 27 December 2024.

card.fact_statement: Astronomer H. Perkins was involved in making the discovery observations of 2025 GN1.
card.source_span: Astronomers involved in making the discovery observations included H. Perkins, T. Murphey, Jan Kleyna, and Robert Weryk.
